title: Claude Code API 中转网关：2 个环境变量接入 - gw-link
description: gw-link 为 Claude Code 提供 Anthropic 兼容的 /v1/messages 接口。设置 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 和 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 即可接入，Key、用量与计费在控制台统一管理。
h1: Claude Code API 网关：两个环境变量完成接入
lead: Claude Code 通过 Anthropic Messages API（/v1/messages）与模型通信。gw-link 提供同一协议的网关入口：把 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 指向 https://gw-link.com，用控制台签发的 sk- 开头的 Key 作为 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN，无需改动 Claude Code 本身。

benefits.title: 原生协议，零改造
benefits.text: gw-link 直接提供 Anthropic 兼容的 /v1/messages 接口，Claude Code 的工具调用、流式输出与长上下文按原样工作，不经过 OpenAI 格式转换。

benefits.title: 一个 Key 管理团队用量
benefits.text: 为每位成员或每个项目单独创建 API Key，可设置额度上限，在控制台查看每个 Key 的调用量与费用。

benefits.title: 两个接入节点
benefits.text: https://gw-link.com 为主节点（三网优化），https://gw-link.ai 为美国节点，按网络环境任选其一，配置方式完全相同。

steps: 注册并登录 gw-link 控制台，在「API 密钥」页创建 Key（选择 Claude 分组）。
设置环境变量 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://gw-link.com 与 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=你的 Key（注意 base_url 不要带 /v1）。
在项目目录运行 claude，发送一条消息验证连通。
如需长期生效，把同样的配置写入 ~/.claude/settings.json 的 env 字段。

snippets.title: macOS / Linux 终端
snippets.code:
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://gw-link.com"
export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="sk-你的gw-link密钥"
export CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1
claude

snippets.title: ~/.claude/settings.json（推荐，长期生效）
Windows PowerShell
snippets.code:
$env:ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://gw-link.com"
$env:ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="sk-你的gw-link密钥"
$env:CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1
claude

faq.q: Claude Code 可以使用 gw-link 吗？
faq.a: 可以。gw-link 提供与 Anthropic 一致的 /v1/messages 接口，Claude Code 只需设置 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 和 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 两个环境变量即可接入，不需要修改代码或安装插件。

faq.q: 还需要单独的 Anthropic API Key 吗？
faq.a: 不需要。使用 gw-link 控制台签发的 sk- 开头的 Key 即可，调用费用从你的 gw-link 账户余额或订阅额度中扣除。

faq.q: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 要不要加 /v1？
faq.a: 不要。Claude Code 会自动在 base_url 后拼接 /v1/messages，填 https://gw-link.com 即可；写成 https://gw-link.com/v1 会变成 /v1/v1/messages 并返回 404。

faq.q: VS Code / JetBrains 里的 Claude Code 也能用吗？
faq.a: 可以。IDE 集成调用的是同一个 Claude Code，写在 ~/.claude/settings.json 的 env 配置同样生效。

faq.q: 支持哪些模型？
faq.a: 以 Key 所属分组的可用模型为准，可以用 curl https://gw-link.com/v1/models -H "Authorization: Bearer 你的Key" 查看当前可用的模型列表。

title: Claude Code API Gateway: Set Up in 2 Env Vars - gw-link
description: Use Claude Code through gw-link's Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages API: set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, then manage keys and usage in one console.
h1: Claude Code API Gateway: Connect with Two Environment Variables
lead: Claude Code talks to models through the Anthropic Messages API (/v1/messages). gw-link serves the same protocol: point ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL at https://gw-link.com and use your console-issued sk- key as ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN. Claude Code itself needs no changes.

benefits.title: Native protocol, no shims
benefits.text: gw-link speaks the Anthropic-compatible /v1/messages API directly, so Claude Code's tool use, streaming and long context work as-is — no OpenAI-format translation in between.

benefits.title: One key per teammate
benefits.text: Create a separate API key per person or project, set spending caps, and see per-key usage and cost in the console.

benefits.title: Two entry points
benefits.text: https://gw-link.com is the primary endpoint and https://gw-link.ai is the US endpoint. Pick whichever is faster from your network; configuration is identical.

steps: Sign up and log in to the gw-link console, then create a key on the API Keys page (choose a Claude group).
Set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://gw-link.com and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=<your key>. Do not append /v1 to the base URL.
Run claude in your project and send a message to confirm the connection.
To make it permanent, put the same values in the env block of ~/.claude/settings.json.

snippets.title: macOS / Linux shell
snippets.code:
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://gw-link.com"
export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="sk-your-gw-link-key"
export CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1
claude

snippets.title: ~/.claude/settings.json (recommended, persistent)
Windows PowerShell
snippets.code:
$env:ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://gw-link.com"
$env:ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="sk-your-gw-link-key"
$env:CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1
claude

faq.q: Does Claude Code work with gw-link?
faq.a: Yes. gw-link exposes the same /v1/messages API as Anthropic, so Claude Code only needs ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN — no code changes or plugins.

faq.q: Do I also need an Anthropic API key?
faq.a: No. Use the sk- key issued by the gw-link console; usage is charged to your gw-link balance or subscription quota.

faq.q: Should ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL include /v1?
faq.a: No. Claude Code appends /v1/messages itself, so use https://gw-link.com. Using https://gw-link.com/v1 produces /v1/v1/messages and a 404.

faq.q: Does it work with Claude Code in VS Code or JetBrains?
faq.a: Yes. The IDE integrations run the same Claude Code, so the env block in ~/.claude/settings.json applies there too.

faq.q: Which models are available?
faq.a: Whatever your key's group allows. List them with curl https://gw-link.com/v1/models -H "Authorization: Bearer <your key>".

title: Claude Code ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 配置指南 - gw-link
description: Claude Code 的 base_url 怎么填？详解 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL、ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 与 settings.json 配置、Windows 写法和常见 404/401 错误。
h1: Claude Code base_url（ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL）配置指南
lead: Claude Code 没有名为 base_url 的配置项，对应的是环境变量 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL。本文说明它该填什么、配合哪个鉴权变量、写在哪里优先级最高，以及最常见的配置错误。

benefits.title: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
benefits.text: 填网关根地址 https://gw-link.com（或美国节点 https://gw-link.ai），不要带 /v1，Claude Code 会自动拼接 /v1/messages。

benefits.title: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
benefits.text: 填 gw-link 的 sk- 密钥，以 Authorization: Bearer 方式发送。用 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY（x-api-key 头）也能被网关识别，但首次启动 Claude Code 会询问是否使用该 Key。

benefits.title: settings.json 的 env
benefits.text: 写在 ~/.claude/settings.json 的 env 字段对所有终端和 IDE 生效，比在 shell 里 export 更稳定，也不会被新终端遗漏。

steps: 在 gw-link 控制台创建 API Key，并点击「使用密钥」查看 Claude Code 配置。
把 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL、ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 写入 ~/.claude/settings.json 的 env 字段。
（可选）设置 ANTHROPIC_MODEL 固定默认模型，模型名以 /v1/models 返回为准。
重新打开终端运行 claude，确认对话正常返回。

snippets.title: ~/.claude/settings.json
临时在当前终端生效
snippets.code:
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://gw-link.com"
export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="sk-你的gw-link密钥"
export CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1
claude

snippets.title: 用 curl 验证 Key 与网络
snippets.code:
curl https://gw-link.com/v1/models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-你的gw-link密钥"
snippets.note: 返回模型列表说明 Key 有效、网络可达；返回 401 说明 Key 有误。

faq.q: Claude Code 的 base_url 应该填什么？
faq.a: 设置环境变量 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://gw-link.com。海外网络可改用 https://gw-link.ai。两者都不要带 /v1 后缀。

faq.q: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN 和 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 用哪个？
faq.a: 推荐 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN（Bearer 鉴权，不会触发确认提示）。gw-link 同时接受 x-api-key，所以 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY 也可以用。两个不要同时设置不同的值。

faq.q: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC 有什么用？
faq.a: 它关闭 Claude Code 的遥测、错误上报等非必要请求，让所有流量只走你配置的网关，减少因无法访问官方服务导致的卡顿。

faq.q: 改了配置还是不生效？
faq.a: 检查是否同时存在 shell 环境变量和 settings.json（shell 中旧的 export 可能覆盖新值），修改后需要重新打开终端或重启 IDE。

title: Claude Code ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL Setup Guide - gw-link
description: What to put in Claude Code's base URL: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, settings.json, Windows syntax and fixes for common 404/401 errors.
h1: Claude Code Base URL (ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL) Setup Guide
lead: Claude Code has no setting literally called base_url — it reads the ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL environment variable. This guide covers what to set it to, which auth variable goes with it, where to put it so it always applies, and the most common mistakes.

benefits.title: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
benefits.text: Use the gateway root https://gw-link.com (or the US endpoint https://gw-link.ai) without /v1 — Claude Code appends /v1/messages itself.

benefits.title: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
benefits.text: Your gw-link sk- key, sent as Authorization: Bearer. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (x-api-key header) is accepted too, but Claude Code asks you to confirm it on first launch.

benefits.title: The env block in settings.json
benefits.text: Values in the env block of ~/.claude/settings.json apply to every terminal and IDE session — more reliable than exporting them in one shell.

steps: Create an API key in the gw-link console and open Use Key to see the Claude Code configuration.
Put ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN in the env block of ~/.claude/settings.json.
Optionally pin a default model with ANTHROPIC_MODEL, using an ID returned by /v1/models.
Open a new terminal, run claude and confirm you get a reply.

snippets.title: ~/.claude/settings.json
Current shell only
snippets.code:
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://gw-link.com"
export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="sk-your-gw-link-key"
export CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1
claude

snippets.title: Verify the key and network with curl
snippets.code:
curl https://gw-link.com/v1/models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-your-gw-link-key"
snippets.note: A model list means the key works and the endpoint is reachable; a 401 means the key is wrong.

faq.q: What should Claude Code's base URL be?
faq.a: Set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://gw-link.com, or https://gw-link.ai for the US endpoint. Never add a /v1 suffix.

faq.q: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN or ANTHROPIC_API_KEY?
faq.a: Prefer ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN (Bearer auth, no confirmation prompt). gw-link also accepts x-api-key, so ANTHROPIC_API_KEY works too — just don't set both to different values.

faq.q: What does CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC do?
faq.a: It turns off Claude Code's telemetry and error-reporting calls so all traffic goes to the gateway you configured, avoiding stalls when those services are unreachable.

faq.q: My change doesn't take effect — why?
faq.a: An older export in your shell profile can override settings.json. Remove duplicates and open a new terminal or restart the IDE after editing.

title: Codex CLI API 中转配置：config.toml 示例 - gw-link
description: 用 gw-link 接入 OpenAI Codex CLI：在 ~/.codex/config.toml 设置 base_url=https://gw-link.com/v1 与 wire_api="responses"，在 auth.json 填入 Key 即可。
h1: Codex CLI 接入 gw-link：config.toml 与 auth.json 配置
lead: Codex CLI 使用 OpenAI Responses API。gw-link 提供兼容的 /v1/responses 接口：在 ~/.codex/config.toml 中声明一个指向 https://gw-link.com/v1 的 model provider，再把 Key 写入 ~/.codex/auth.json，Codex CLI 与 IDE 扩展即可使用。

benefits.title: Responses API 原生兼容
benefits.text: wire_api 设为 responses，Codex 的工具调用、推理与流式输出直接走 /v1/responses，无需额外代理。

benefits.title: 与 Claude Code 共用账户
benefits.text: 同一个 gw-link 账户可同时为 Codex 与 Claude Code 签发不同的 Key，余额与用量集中管理。

benefits.title: 适合脚本与 CI
benefits.text: codex exec 等非交互命令同样读取 config.toml，适合在自动化任务中复用同一套配置。

steps: 在 gw-link 控制台创建 Key（选择 OpenAI / GPT 分组），点击「使用密钥」切换到 Codex 标签页。
把 config.toml 内容写入 ~/.codex/config.toml（Windows 为 %USERPROFILE%\.codex\config.toml）。
把 Key 写入同目录下的 auth.json。
运行 codex，输入一个简单任务验证响应。

snippets.title: ~/.codex/config.toml
snippets.code:
model_provider = "OpenAI"
model = "gpt-5.5"
review_model = "gpt-5.5"
disable_response_storage = true

[model_providers.OpenAI]
name = "OpenAI"
base_url = "https://gw-link.com/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
requires_openai_auth = true
snippets.note: base_url 必须带 /v1；model 以控制台可用模型为准。

snippets.title: ~/.codex/auth.json

faq.q: Codex 的 base_url 要不要带 /v1？
faq.a: 要。Codex 会在 base_url 后直接拼接 /responses，所以必须写成 https://gw-link.com/v1。这一点和 Claude Code 相反。

faq.q: wire_api 应该填什么？
faq.a: 填 "responses"。新版 Codex 只支持 Responses API，gw-link 的 /v1/responses 与之兼容。

faq.q: 启动后提示登录 ChatGPT 怎么办？
faq.a: 确认 config.toml 中的 model_provider 指向你配置的 provider，并且 ~/.codex/auth.json 里有 OPENAI_API_KEY。配置正确时 Codex 会直接使用该 Key。

faq.q: Codex 能和 Claude Code 共用 gw-link 吗？
faq.a: 可以。两者使用各自的配置文件，可以用同一个账户下的不同 Key，分别统计用量。

title: Codex CLI API Gateway: config.toml Example - gw-link
description: Connect OpenAI Codex CLI to gw-link: set base_url = https://gw-link.com/v1 and wire_api = "responses" in ~/.codex/config.toml, then put your key in auth.json.
h1: Connect Codex CLI to gw-link: config.toml and auth.json
lead: Codex CLI uses the OpenAI Responses API. gw-link serves a compatible /v1/responses endpoint: declare a model provider pointing at https://gw-link.com/v1 in ~/.codex/config.toml, put your key in ~/.codex/auth.json, and both the CLI and the IDE extension are ready.

benefits.title: Native Responses API
benefits.text: With wire_api = "responses", Codex tool calls, reasoning and streaming go straight to /v1/responses — no extra proxy.

benefits.title: Shared account with Claude Code
benefits.text: One gw-link account can issue separate keys for Codex and Claude Code, with balance and usage in one place.

benefits.title: Works in scripts and CI
benefits.text: Non-interactive commands such as codex exec read the same config.toml, so automation reuses one setup.

steps: Create a key in the gw-link console (OpenAI / GPT group) and open Use Key → Codex.
Save the config.toml content to ~/.codex/config.toml (%USERPROFILE%\.codex\config.toml on Windows).
Save your key to auth.json in the same directory.
Run codex and try a small task to confirm it responds.

snippets.title: ~/.codex/config.toml
snippets.code:
model_provider = "OpenAI"
model = "gpt-5.5"
review_model = "gpt-5.5"
disable_response_storage = true

[model_providers.OpenAI]
name = "OpenAI"
base_url = "https://gw-link.com/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
requires_openai_auth = true
snippets.note: base_url must end with /v1; pick a model your console lists.

snippets.title: ~/.codex/auth.json

faq.q: Does Codex's base_url need /v1?
faq.a: Yes. Codex appends /responses directly, so use https://gw-link.com/v1 — the opposite of Claude Code.

faq.q: What should wire_api be?
faq.a: "responses". Current Codex releases only speak the Responses API, which gw-link's /v1/responses supports.

faq.q: Codex asks me to sign in to ChatGPT — what now?
faq.a: Check that model_provider in config.toml points at the provider you defined and that ~/.codex/auth.json contains OPENAI_API_KEY. With both in place Codex uses the key directly.

faq.q: Can Codex and Claude Code share gw-link?
faq.a: Yes. Each uses its own config file; you can give them separate keys under one account to track usage independently.

title: Gemini CLI 中转配置：GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL - gw-link
description: 用 gw-link 接入 Gemini CLI：设置 GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL=https://gw-link.com 与 GEMINI_API_KEY，即可通过 Gemini 原生接口使用模型。
h1: Gemini CLI 接入 gw-link：GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL 配置
lead: Gemini CLI 使用 Gemini 原生 API（/v1beta）。gw-link 提供兼容的 /v1beta 接口：设置 GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL 指向网关根地址、GEMINI_API_KEY 填入控制台签发的 Key，即可在终端里使用 Gemini 模型，并与 Claude Code、Codex 共用一个账户。

benefits.title: Gemini 原生协议
benefits.text: gw-link 直接提供 /v1beta 接口并兼容 x-goog-api-key 鉴权，Gemini CLI 无需任何格式转换。

benefits.title: 跨工具统一账户
benefits.text: Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 使用同一个 gw-link 账户，不同工具用不同 Key，余额统一管理。

benefits.title: 配置只有两项
benefits.text: GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL 与 GEMINI_API_KEY，可写入 shell 配置文件长期生效。

steps: 在 gw-link 控制台创建 Key（选择 Gemini 分组），点击「使用密钥」查看 Gemini CLI 配置。
设置 GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL=https://gw-link.com（不要带 /v1beta）与 GEMINI_API_KEY。
运行 gemini；如提示选择认证方式，选择「Use Gemini API Key」。
发送一条消息确认模型正常返回。

snippets.title: macOS / Linux 终端
snippets.code:
export GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL="https://gw-link.com"
export GEMINI_API_KEY="sk-你的gw-link密钥"
gemini
snippets.note: 可选：export GEMINI_MODEL=<模型名> 指定默认模型，模型名以控制台为准。

faq.q: GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL 要不要带 /v1beta？
faq.a: 不要。Gemini CLI 会自动拼接 /v1beta/models/...，填 https://gw-link.com 即可。

faq.q: 需要 Google 账号登录吗？
faq.a: 不需要。设置 GEMINI_API_KEY 后 Gemini CLI 以 API Key 方式鉴权，使用的是 gw-link 签发的 Key。

faq.q: Gemini CLI 是否适合接入 API 网关？
faq.a: 适合，尤其是团队需要统一管理 Key、额度和多种 AI 编程工具的成本时。

title: Gemini CLI API Gateway: GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL - gw-link
description: Connect Gemini CLI to gw-link: set GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL=https://gw-link.com and GEMINI_API_KEY to use Gemini models through the native API.
h1: Connect Gemini CLI to gw-link with GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL
lead: Gemini CLI uses the native Gemini API (/v1beta). gw-link serves a compatible /v1beta endpoint: point GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL at the gateway root, put your console-issued key in GEMINI_API_KEY, and use Gemini models from the terminal on the same account as Claude Code and Codex.

benefits.title: Native Gemini protocol
benefits.text: gw-link serves /v1beta directly and accepts x-goog-api-key auth, so Gemini CLI needs no format translation.

benefits.title: One account across tools
benefits.text: Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI share one gw-link account, each with its own key and one balance.

benefits.title: Just two settings
benefits.text: GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL and GEMINI_API_KEY — add them to your shell profile to make them permanent.

steps: Create a key in the gw-link console (Gemini group) and open Use Key → Gemini CLI.
Set GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL=https://gw-link.com (no /v1beta) and GEMINI_API_KEY.
Run gemini; if asked how to authenticate, choose Use Gemini API Key.
Send a message to confirm the model responds.

snippets.title: macOS / Linux shell
snippets.code:
export GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL="https://gw-link.com"
export GEMINI_API_KEY="sk-your-gw-link-key"
gemini
snippets.note: Optional: export GEMINI_MODEL=<model> to set a default; use a model your console lists.

faq.q: Should GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL include /v1beta?
faq.a: No. Gemini CLI appends /v1beta/models/... itself; use https://gw-link.com.

faq.q: Do I need to sign in with a Google account?
faq.a: No. With GEMINI_API_KEY set, Gemini CLI authenticates with that key — the one issued by gw-link.

faq.q: Is an API gateway a good fit for Gemini CLI?
faq.a: Yes, especially when a team wants one place to manage keys, quotas and spend across several AI coding tools.

title: OpenAI 兼容 API 中转：base_url 替换即用 - gw-link

benefits.title: 完整的 OpenAI 接口
benefits.text: 支持 /v1/chat/completions、/v1/responses、/v1/embeddings、/v1/images/generations 与 /v1/models，覆盖对话、Agent、向量和图像场景。

faq.q: OpenAI compatible 是什么意思？

faq.q: Cherry Studio、Chatbox、Cline、Continue 等客户端能用吗？

faq.q: 鉴权头用哪个？

faq.q: 怎么知道有哪些模型？

title: GPT-Image-2 API 调用教程：文生图与图生图 - gw-link

guideTitle: 图像 API 接入步骤

benefits.title: 文生图
benefits.text: 用 /v1/images/generations 根据提示词生成产品图、教程配图和营销素材，返回 base64 图片数据。

解码返回的 b64_json 并保存为图片文件。
按需接入自己的发布或审核流程。

snippets.title: curl 文生图
snippets.code:
curl https://gw-link.com/v1/images/generations \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-你的gw-link密钥" \

snippets.title: Python 保存图片
snippets.code:
import base64
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://gw-link.com/v1", api_key="sk-你的gw-link密钥")

title: CC Switch 配置教程：Claude Code / Codex 一键切换 - gw-link
description: 用 CC Switch 管理 gw-link 的 Claude Code 与 Codex 配置：控制台一键「导入到 CCS」，或手动添加 Provider，在多个 Key、节点与模型间快速切换。
h1: CC Switch 配置 gw-link：多 Provider、Key 与模型一键切换
lead: CC Switch 是一个管理 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编程工具配置的桌面应用，可以在多个 Provider 之间一键切换。gw-link 控制台的 API 密钥页内置「导入到 CCS」按钮，点击即可把 Key 与 base_url 写入 CC Switch。

benefits.title: 一键导入
benefits.text: 在 gw-link「API 密钥」页点击「导入到 CCS」，通过 ccswitch:// 协议把 Provider 配置直接写入 CC Switch。

benefits.title: 多节点、多 Key 切换
benefits.text: 可以把 gw-link.com 与 gw-link.ai 两个节点、或不同分组的 Key 各存为一个 Provider，按需切换。

benefits.title: 不再手改配置文件
benefits.text: CC Switch 负责改写 ~/.claude/settings.json 与 ~/.codex 下的配置，避免手动编辑出错。

steps: 安装 CC Switch 桌面应用。
在 gw-link 控制台「API 密钥」页，点击目标 Key 的「导入到 CCS」。
如未弹出导入窗口，可在 CC Switch 中手动新增 Provider，填入下方配置。
在 CC Switch 中启用该 Provider，然后重新打开 Claude Code 或 Codex。

snippets.title: 手动添加 Claude Code Provider
snippets.note: CC Switch 的 Claude Code Provider 配置即 settings.json 的 env 内容。

snippets.title: 手动添加 Codex Provider（config.toml）
snippets.code:
model_provider = "OpenAI"
model = "gpt-5.5"
review_model = "gpt-5.5"
disable_response_storage = true

[model_providers.OpenAI]
name = "OpenAI"
base_url = "https://gw-link.com/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
requires_openai_auth = true

faq.q: CC Switch 是一个模型吗？
faq.a: 不是。它是配置管理工具，负责在多个 Provider、Key 和模型配置之间切换，模型调用仍然经由 gw-link。

faq.q: 点击「导入到 CCS」没有反应？
faq.a: 说明 CC Switch 未安装或 ccswitch:// 协议未注册。安装后重试，或按上方配置在 CC Switch 中手动添加。

faq.q: 可以同时保存国内和海外节点吗？
faq.a: 可以。分别以 https://gw-link.com 与 https://gw-link.ai 为 base_url 建两个 Provider，网络环境变化时一键切换。

title: CC Switch Setup for gw-link: Claude Code & Codex - gw-link
description: Manage gw-link configs for Claude Code and Codex with CC Switch: one-click Import to CCS from the console, then switch keys, endpoints and models.
h1: CC Switch with gw-link: Switch Providers, Keys and Models in One Click
lead: CC Switch is a desktop app that manages configuration for AI coding tools such as Claude Code and Codex and switches between providers in one click. The gw-link API Keys page has a built-in Import to CCS button that writes the key and base URL into CC Switch for you.

benefits.title: One-click import
benefits.text: On the gw-link API Keys page, click Import to CCS to push the provider config into CC Switch via the ccswitch:// protocol.

benefits.title: Multiple endpoints and keys
benefits.text: Save gw-link.com and gw-link.ai, or keys from different groups, as separate providers and switch as needed.

benefits.title: No hand-edited files
benefits.text: CC Switch rewrites ~/.claude/settings.json and the files under ~/.codex, so you don't edit them by hand.

steps: Install the CC Switch desktop app.
In the gw-link console, open API Keys and click Import to CCS on the key you want.
If no import dialog appears, add a provider in CC Switch manually with the config below.
Enable the provider in CC Switch, then reopen Claude Code or Codex.

model_provider = "OpenAI"
model = "gpt-5.5"
review_model = "gpt-5.5"

faq.q: Import to CCS does nothing — why?

faq.q: Can I keep both endpoints?
faq.a: Yes. Create one provider with https://gw-link.com and another with https://gw-link.ai, then switch when your network changes.

title: Claude Code vs Codex：协议、配置与工作流对比 - gw-link
description: 对比 Claude Code 与 Codex CLI 的 API 协议、配置文件、base_url 写法与适用场景，并说明如何用一个 gw-link 账户同时接入两者。
h1: Claude Code vs Codex：API 协议、配置与工作流对比
lead: Claude Code（Anthropic）与 Codex CLI（OpenAI）都是终端里的 AI 编程 Agent，但使用不同的 API 协议和配置方式。了解差异可以少踩配置坑，也便于团队让两者共存。

benefits.title: Claude Code
benefits.text: Anthropic Messages API（/v1/messages）；配置 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL（不带 /v1）与 ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN，写在 ~/.claude/settings.json；使用 Claude 系列模型。

benefits.title: Codex CLI
benefits.text: OpenAI Responses API（/v1/responses）；配置 ~/.codex/config.toml（base_url 带 /v1，wire_api = "responses"）与 auth.json；使用 GPT 系列模型。

benefits.title: gw-link 统一接入
benefits.text: 两种协议由同一网关提供，一个账户为两个工具分别签发 Key，余额、额度与用量统一管理。

steps: 确定团队主要使用的工具与模型偏好，两者可以同时安装。
Claude Code：设置 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://gw-link.com 与 Key。
Codex：在 config.toml 中设置 base_url=https://gw-link.com/v1 与 wire_api="responses"。
为两个工具分别创建 Key，便于按工具统计用量与成本。

snippets.title: Claude Code（~/.claude/settings.json）
Codex（~/.codex/config.toml）
snippets.code:
model_provider = "OpenAI"
model = "gpt-5.5"
review_model = "gpt-5.5"
disable_response_storage = true

[model_providers.OpenAI]
name = "OpenAI"
base_url = "https://gw-link.com/v1"

requires_openai_auth = true

faq.q: Claude Code 和 Codex 必须二选一吗？

faq.q: 两者的 base_url 写法有什么区别？
faq.a: Claude Code 填根地址 https://gw-link.com（客户端自动拼接 /v1/messages）；Codex 必须填 https://gw-link.com/v1（客户端只拼接 /responses）。

faq.q: 能用同一个 Key 吗？
faq.a: Key 的可用模型由其所属分组决定。通常建议为 Claude Code 与 Codex 各建一个对应分组的 Key，便于分别统计。

title: Claude Code vs Codex: Protocol, Config & Workflow - gw-link
description: Compare Claude Code and Codex CLI: API protocol, config files, base URL rules and use cases — and how to run both from one gw-link account.
h1: Claude Code vs Codex: API Protocol, Configuration and Workflow
lead: Claude Code (Anthropic) and Codex CLI (OpenAI) are both terminal AI coding agents, but they use different API protocols and configuration. Knowing the differences avoids setup mistakes and lets a team run both side by side.

benefits.title: Claude Code
benefits.text: Anthropic Messages API (/v1/messages); set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL (no /v1) and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN in ~/.claude/settings.json; uses Claude models.

benefits.title: Codex CLI
benefits.text: OpenAI Responses API (/v1/responses); configure ~/.codex/config.toml (base_url with /v1, wire_api = "responses") plus auth.json; uses GPT models.

benefits.title: One gateway for both
benefits.text: gw-link serves both protocols, so one account issues a key per tool and tracks balance, caps and usage together.

steps: Decide which tool and models your team prefers — installing both is fine.
Claude Code: set ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://gw-link.com and your key.
Codex: set base_url = https://gw-link.com/v1 and wire_api = "responses" in config.toml.
Create a key per tool so usage and cost are tracked separately.

snippets.title: Claude Code (~/.claude/settings.json)
Codex (~/.codex/config.toml)
snippets.code:
model_provider = "OpenAI"
model = "gpt-5.5"
review_model = "gpt-5.5"
disable_response_storage = true

[model_providers.OpenAI]
name = "OpenAI"
base_url = "https://gw-link.com/v1"
wire_api = "responses"
requires_openai_auth = true

faq.q: Do I have to pick one?
faq.a: No. Their config files don't conflict, and both can run on the same gw-link account.

faq.q: How do the base URLs differ?
faq.a: Claude Code uses the root https://gw-link.com (it appends /v1/messages). Codex needs https://gw-link.com/v1 (it only appends /responses).

faq.q: Can they share one key?
faq.a: A key's models are set by its group. Usually create one key per tool on the matching group so usage is tracked separately.

lead: 从注册到完成第一次请求只需要三步：创建 API Key、把工具的 base_url 指向 gw-link、发送测试请求。控制台的「使用密钥」会按工具生成可直接复制的配置。

benefits.title: 1. 创建 Key

faq.a: 已安装 Claude Code、Codex 或 Gemini CLI 的情况下，复制配置并验证通常只需要几分钟。

faq.q: gw-link.com 和 gw-link.ai 用哪个？
faq.a: 两者功能相同：gw-link.com 为主节点（三网优化），gw-link.ai 为美国节点，选择从你的网络访问更快的那个即可。

faq.q: base_url 到底带不带 /v1？
faq.a: Claude Code 与 Gemini CLI 填根地址 https://gw-link.com；Codex 与 OpenAI SDK 填 https://gw-link.com/v1。

title: gw-link Quick Start: Claude Code, Codex & Gemini CLI
description: gw-link quick start: sign up, create an API key, copy the config for your tool and verify. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and OpenAI SDK settings at a glance.
h1: gw-link Quick Start: Connected in 3 Minutes
lead: Three steps from sign-up to your first request: create an API key, point your tool's base URL at gw-link, and send a test request. The console's Use Key dialog generates copy-paste config for each tool.

benefits.title: 1. Create a key
benefits.text: Log in, open API Keys, create a key and choose the group for your platform (Claude / OpenAI / Gemini, etc.).

benefits.title: 2. Configure your tool
benefits.text: Click Use Key, pick the Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or OpenCode tab and copy the generated config.

benefits.title: 3. Verify
benefits.text: Check the key and network with /v1/models, then send a message from your tool.

steps: Sign up and log in to gw-link, then top up or subscribe.
Create an API key and choose its group.
Copy the config from Use Key into your tool.
Run the curl command below; a model list means you're connected.

snippets.title: Verify your key
snippets.code:
curl https://gw-link.com/v1/models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-your-gw-link-key"

snippets.title: Claude Code
snippets.code:
export ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL="https://gw-link.com"
export ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN="sk-your-gw-link-key"
export CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1
claude

snippets.title: Gemini CLI
snippets.code:
export GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL="https://gw-link.com"
export GEMINI_API_KEY="sk-your-gw-link-key"
gemini

faq.q: How fast can I get set up?
faq.a: With Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI already installed, copying the config and verifying usually takes a few minutes.

faq.q: gw-link.com or gw-link.ai?
faq.a: They work the same: gw-link.com is the primary endpoint and gw-link.ai is the US endpoint. Use whichever is faster from your network.

faq.q: Does the base URL include /v1?
faq.a: Claude Code and Gemini CLI use the root https://gw-link.com; Codex and the OpenAI SDK use https://gw-link.com/v1.

title: gw-link 排障：401、403、404、429 错误原因与解决 - gw-link
description: 排查 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 接入 gw-link 时的 401 Key 无效、403 余额不足、404 路径错误、429 额度用尽与模型不存在等问题。
h1: gw-link 常见错误与排障清单
lead: 绝大多数接入问题来自三类原因：Key、base_url 路径、模型名。先用 /v1/models 验证 Key 与网络，再按错误码对照下面的清单定位。

benefits.title: 401 INVALID_API_KEY
benefits.text: Key 错误、已删除或复制不完整；也可能是终端读到了旧的环境变量。重新复制 Key 并打开新终端。

benefits.title: 403 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE / SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_FOUND
benefits.text: 余额不足需充值；Key 所属分组是订阅分组但账户没有有效订阅时，需要开通订阅或换用余额分组的 Key。

benefits.title: 429 API_KEY_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
benefits.text: 该 Key 设置的额度已用完，可在控制台调高额度或换用其它 Key；短时间请求过多也会返回 429，稍后重试。

benefits.title: 404 / 路径错误
benefits.text: Claude Code、Gemini CLI 的 base_url 不要带 /v1；Codex、OpenAI SDK 的 base_url 必须带 /v1。

steps: 运行 curl https://gw-link.com/v1/models 验证 Key 与网络。
核对 base_url 是否符合所用工具的要求（是否带 /v1）。
确认模型名出现在 /v1/models 返回的列表中。
在控制台检查余额、订阅状态与 Key 额度。

snippets.title: 第一步：验证 Key
snippets.code:
curl https://gw-link.com/v1/models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-你的gw-link密钥"
snippets.note: 返回 JSON 模型列表即 Key 有效；401 为 Key 问题；超时或连接失败为网络问题，可换用 https://gw-link.ai 测试。

faq.q: 401 一般是什么原因？
faq.a: 通常是 API Key 错误、已删除、复制时缺了字符，或工具读取了旧的环境变量。gw-link 的 Key 以 sk- 开头。

faq.q: 提示模型不存在怎么办？
faq.a: 模型名必须出现在 Key 所属分组的可用模型中，调用 /v1/models 查看准确的模型 ID，并检查工具里配置的模型名是否拼写一致。

faq.q: 返回 503 是什么意思？
faq.a: 表示网关或上游暂时繁忙，属于临时性错误，稍后重试即可；持续出现请联系客服。

faq.q: Claude Code 报 404？
faq.a: 多半是 ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL 写成了 https://gw-link.com/v1，导致请求变成 /v1/v1/messages。改为 https://gw-link.com。

title: gw-link Troubleshooting: Fix 401, 403, 404 & 429 Errors
description: Fix common gw-link errors in Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI: 401 invalid key, 403 insufficient balance, 404 wrong path, 429 quota exhausted, unknown model.
h1: gw-link Error Reference and Troubleshooting Checklist
lead: Almost every setup problem comes down to the key, the base URL path or the model name. Verify the key and network with /v1/models first, then match the error code below.

benefits.title: 401 INVALID_API_KEY
benefits.text: The key is wrong, deleted or truncated, or your terminal still has an old environment variable. Re-copy the key and open a new terminal.

benefits.title: 403 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE / SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_FOUND
benefits.text: Top up if your balance is empty. If the key's group is subscription-only and you have no active subscription, subscribe or use a key on a balance group.

benefits.title: 429 API_KEY_QUOTA_EXHAUSTED
benefits.text: The key's spending cap is used up — raise it in the console or use another key. Too many requests in a short time also return 429; retry later.

benefits.title: 404 / wrong path
benefits.text: Claude Code and Gemini CLI base URLs must not include /v1; Codex and OpenAI SDK base URLs must.

steps: Run curl https://gw-link.com/v1/models to check the key and network.
Check the base URL matches your tool's rule (with or without /v1).
Confirm the model ID appears in the /v1/models list.
Check balance, subscription status and key caps in the console.

snippets.title: Step 1: verify the key
snippets.code:
curl https://gw-link.com/v1/models \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-your-gw-link-key"
snippets.note: A JSON model list means the key is valid; 401 is a key problem; timeouts mean a network problem — try https://gw-link.ai.

faq.q: What usually causes a 401?
faq.a: A wrong, deleted or truncated API key, or a tool reading an old environment variable. gw-link keys start with sk-.

faq.q: It says the model doesn't exist — what now?
faq.a: The model must be available to your key's group. Call /v1/models for the exact IDs and check the spelling in your tool.

faq.q: What does a 503 mean?
faq.a: The gateway or upstream is temporarily busy. It's transient — retry shortly, and contact support if it persists.

faq.q: Claude Code returns 404?
faq.a: Most likely ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL is https://gw-link.com/v1, producing /v1/v1/messages. Change it to https://gw-link.com.

title: gw-link 价格与计费方式：余额按量与订阅额度 - gw-link
description: 了解 gw-link 的计费方式：余额按实际用量扣费、订阅分组按日/周/月额度使用，每个 API Key 可单独设置额度上限，适合个人与团队 AI 编程。
h1: gw-link 价格与计费方式
lead: gw-link 支持两种用法：充值余额后按实际调用用量扣费，或开通订阅后在套餐额度内使用。具体模型价格与套餐请在首页定价区或控制台查看。

benefits.title: 余额按量计费
benefits.text: 每次请求按模型与实际 Token 用量从余额扣费，用多少付多少，余额不足时请求返回 403 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE。

benefits.title: 订阅额度
benefits.text: 订阅分组可设置日、周、月用量上限，适合使用量稳定的个人与团队。

benefits.title: 按 Key 控制成本
benefits.text: 为每个工具或成员创建独立 Key 并设置额度上限，用尽后该 Key 返回 429，不影响其它 Key。

steps: 在首页定价区或控制台查看模型价格与订阅套餐。
选择充值余额或开通订阅。
为不同工具、成员创建独立 Key 并设置额度。
定期在控制台查看用量，按任务选择性价比更高的模型。

faq.q: 适合团队使用吗？
faq.a: 适合。按成员或项目分配 Key、设置额度并集中查看用量，是 gw-link 的核心场景。

faq.q: 余额快用完会提醒吗？
faq.a: 支持低余额提醒，余额低于阈值时会发送通知，避免工作中途中断。

faq.q: 在哪里看具体价格？
faq.a: 首页的定价区与控制台展示各模型的实时价格和订阅套餐，以页面显示为准。

title: gw-link Pricing: Pay-as-You-Go Balance & Subscriptions
description: How gw-link billing works: pay-as-you-go from your balance, or subscription groups with daily/weekly/monthly quotas, plus per-key spending caps for teams.
h1: gw-link Pricing and Billing
lead: gw-link offers two ways to pay: top up a balance and pay for actual usage, or subscribe and use the plan's quota. See current model prices and plans in the pricing section of the homepage or in the console.

benefits.title: Pay as you go
benefits.text: Each request is charged from your balance by model and actual token usage; when the balance runs out, requests return 403 INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.

benefits.title: Subscription quotas
benefits.text: Subscription groups can have daily, weekly and monthly usage caps — good for steady individual or team usage.

benefits.title: Per-key caps
benefits.text: Give each tool or teammate its own key with a spending cap; an exhausted key returns 429 without affecting the others.

steps: Check model prices and plans on the homepage or in the console.
Top up your balance or subscribe.
Create separate keys per tool or teammate and set caps.
Review usage regularly and pick cost-effective models per task.

faq.q: Is it suitable for teams?
faq.a: Yes. Issuing keys per person or project, capping them and reviewing usage centrally is the core use case.

faq.q: Will I be warned before my balance runs out?
faq.a: Yes, low-balance notifications are sent when your balance drops below a threshold, so work isn't interrupted.

faq.q: Where can I see exact prices?
faq.a: The pricing section on the homepage and the console show current per-model prices and plans.
